name: OpenSearch
line: Open-source search and analytics engine for documents and vector retrieval.

free.text: Apache-2.0; no hosted quota or idle rule; you manage disks and retention

cells.metered: Software $0; server and storage costs are separate

sql.math: $0 software fee. Host size and count, disk, replicas, transfer, backups and model costs are not priced.
The software stays $0. Kept compute, storage, snapshots and provider minimums decide the idle cost.

files.math: OpenSearch is not a general file store.

jobs.math: OpenSearch does not run customer application jobs
